description: V0.5b live smoke test: a local OpenAI-compatible server (its address in DREAMTEAM_LLM_BASE_URL, never committed); no API key is needed, one is read from DREAMTEAM_LLM_API_KEY if set. The same model as V0.5a's smoke test, kept so that the slice changes the agent, not the model; no prices are configured, as a local model has no billing. Memory, observation, catalog and details settings are the defaults, stated.
